task_desc: Code review adversarial experiment. Test whether the code review process covers all finding categories (bug, security, performance, readability). If a category is missing, the review must not be considered complete.
Test design coverage measurement. When designing test scenarios for an epic, all acceptance criteria must be covered. There must be at least one test scenario for each AC.
Custom TOML activation_steps experiment. Test that activation_steps_append in a custom TOML file works in the correct format: steps must run in order, and the process must stop at a failing step.

Hook engine config resolve experiment. Test whether resolve_customization.py merges TOML files in the correct order (base → team → user). Deep merge must work correctly: scalars must be overridden and arrays appended.

LLM non-determinism robustness experiment. Ask the LLM for an experiment record 4 times with the same input and measure the consistency of the outputs. All outputs must contain the 5 mandatory fields.
Pipeline integration experiment. Test that all hooks (guard, stop, quality, deploy, audit) work consistently together: even if guard denies, audit must log; even if stop blocks, audit must log.
